name: Cell Observatory Platform

55555.label: PostgreSQL Database (mapped from container port 5432 to host port 55555)

postCreateCommand: cd /workspace/cell_observatory_platform && export PATH=$PATH:/home/ubuntu/.local/bin && pip install bpytop --user --no-dependencies && cp ~/.bashrc /tmp/host_bashrc && echo 'source /tmp/host_bashrc' >> ~/.bashrc && python3 --version
postStartCommand: cd /workspace/cell_observatory_platform && export PATH=$PATH:/home/ubuntu/.local/bin && export PYTHONPATH=/workspace:/workspace/cell_observatory_platform:/workspace:/workspace/cell_observatory_platform:/workspace/ops3d && echo ' ' && echo 'pip installing workspace folder from source...' && pip install -e . --user --force-reinstall --no-deps && source ~/.bashrc && echo '' && echo 'Apptainer instance run: postgres database in background...' && apptainer instance run --no-mount proc --writable --env POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres /scratch/sandbox myjunk -c 'config_file=/etc/postgresql/postgresql.conf' && echo ' ' && echo 'Test database connection to ${SUPABASE_LOCAL_URI}...' && psql postgresql://postgres@localhost/postgres --command="SELECT COUNT(*) NUMBER_OF_ROWS_IN_PREPARED FROM PREPARED;"
